requirements.quote:
Create the report in the file

    /home/user/incident/unhealthy_containers.log

2. Line 1 is the literal, fixed timestamp shown below – do **not** generate the current time:  
   2024-01-01T00:00:00Z

Example (this is exactly what the grading script will expect for the sample data that is already in docker_ps.out):  
       redis-cache | Exited (1) 30 minutes ago
lists every *unhealthy* container (anything whose STATUS does **not** begin with the word “Up”)
1. The report is plain UTF-8 text (no colour codes, no extra spaces at line ends).

check.cmd: iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 /home/user/incident/unhealthy_containers.log >/dev/null && ! LC_ALL=C grep -q "$(printf '\033')" /home/user/incident/unhealthy_containers.log && ! grep -qE '[[:space:]]$' /home/user/incident/unhealthy_containers.log

requirements.quote: 4. There must be a final trailing newline character at the end of the file.
Last step: get rid of `/srv/shared/cobalt` (the whole directory) to reclaim disk space.
